List-column from record fields

Source: R/graph_tables.R
dagri_table_list.Rd

Internal helper for the tabular accessors. Extracts field from every record in records, verbatim, as one cell per row. Graphs store these fields as plain lists, so the cells are plain lists; no graph or record objects leak into cells. An empty record list yields the empty list() column of the empty-graph skeleton.

Usage

dagri_table_list(records, field)

Arguments

records

Named list of records (nodes, edges, or gates).

field

Name of the list field to extract.

Value

Unnamed list with one cell per record, in record (insertion) order.
